original.reason: It proves only a right inverse. For a possibly noncommutative ring, the reverse product must also be shown to establish that 1+x is a unit.

judgment.reason: It correctly constructs and verifies a two-sided inverse.
The reverse identity is justified because the proposed inverse is a polynomial in x and hence commutes with 1+x.
The telescoping products correctly give a two-sided inverse.
The finite geometric-series identity is applied correctly and establishes both inverse identities.
